
 Usage: houston down [OPTIONS]

 Remove a repro's containers. Keeps data (and the record) unless --volumes.

╭─ Options ──╮
 --name     -n      <str>
 --volumes                 also delete the data volume and forget the repro
 --yes      -y             skip the confirmation prompt (for scripts/CI)
 --json                    print the result as one JSON envelope; --volumes then requires --yes
 --help                    Show this message and exit.
╰──╯
